Workbook validation failed due to missing values (None) in expected data ranges H12:L17 and H35:L40.
The test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats failed with multiple AssertionErrors. Specifically, cells in the 'top block' (H12:L17) and 'net metric' (H35:L40) ranges returned None instead of the expected numeric values (e.g., H12 expected 612.5, H35 expected 4.499). This suggests the workbook generation logic is failing to populate or calculate these specific cell ranges in the 'Task' worksheet.
